recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Priestess, Lovers and the Numbers 73 and 67", "body": "Chance explained that he chose the Priestess and Lovers cards as his lens for the episode, and tracked the Hebrew letter gimel and the number 73 for the Priestess and zayin and 67 for the Lovers, along with 37 as its reverse. He reported finding those numbers in scene after scene, including the name Sigmund Freud, which he said added up to 67 in septenary gematria. Gabe noted that Chance read the show through the septenary cipher while he leaned on ordinal. Chance said he still did not know whether writers, AI, demons or God were behind the patterns."}, {"title": "Automats, the Golem and Automated McDonald's", "body": "One of the hosts traced the automat to the word automata and tied it to the idea of a predetermined universe, then linked it to McDonald's moving toward fully automated restaurants. The same host described the Hebrew word golem as a lump of clay given life with letters, and read it as a symbol of the legal straw man and of humans made machine-like by programming. Later the hosts discussed the Ark, the Greek number 37 and Sylvie sheltering at a 1982 McDonald's, offered as their own symbolic readings."}, {"title": "Mobius, Morpheus and the Movie Mobile", "body": "One of the hosts argued that the name Mobius echoed Morpheus, the Greek god of sleep, through the P and B letter swap, and suggested Mobius preferred to stay asleep rather than learn who he had been. That host also played with the B to V swap that turned Mobius into movies, and compared the Mobius strip to a film strip and to a mobile hung over a crib. The hosts agreed that entertainment could be entrainment, while enjoying rewatching a show for its layers."}, {"title": "The Brocken Specter and Chasing Your Shadow", "body": "Chance described the Brocken specter, the halo of light and shadow seen from Mount Brocken, as the visual of the loom scene, and read Coleridge's poem and Jung's dream about a shadow following him in the wind. He said the shadow was the unconscious part of a person beyond their control, and that every main character was chasing a true self outside the illusion of the TVA. He called the effect akin to television and said Gabe would add more, which led into a talk about the torch and the glory."}, {"title": "Gabe's Cicadas, Eggs and Geometry", "body": "Gabe tied the episode to the cicada broods due that spring, saying the Emperor card matched the scratchy stick instrument of capoeira and that he now saw the cicadas in the show's orange, brown and black colors. He described the helter-skelter staircase as an egg rack and said eggs were being seeded into minds. Later he showed that his phone easel had the same shape as Sylvie's altar, and argued geometry was the highest order of communication, then tied the Hermit card and a paper boat to the plot."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The DeMystifiers continue the analysis of Loki Season 2, episode 2, Breaking Brad, to discuss the hidden symbolism of the Golem, the rise of automatic society and robot humans, the Ark and the destruction & regeneration of the universe, McDonald's (of all things!), and how the Lovers and Priestess card play so heavily into the metaphor in this episode. As usual, this thing is deep beyond your wildest imaginings, so don't miss out! Sure to be an enjoyable learning experience regardless of if you've followed the Loki TV show or our previous talks about it.
